title: Admin Setup & Voice Numbering
summary: Makes Membership and Welcome configuration easy to find from Administration and adds persistent automatic numbering for Join-to-Create temporary voice rooms, including superscript names such as BOM¹, BOM² and BOM³.

sections.title: Membership setup is now discoverable
items: Administration now includes a first-class Membership & Welcome destination instead of hiding server-wide onboarding settings inside the Members module.

Welcome channel, Diplomacy, roster membership, Member Console, Custom Roles, Guild Prefix and Role Connections remain the same underlying systems and can still be reached from Members when appropriate.
The Administration home and module directory now link directly to Membership & Welcome.

sections.title: Temporary voice room numbering
items: Admin Basic now exposes the actual Join-to-Create rule editor rather than only showing active temporary listening sessions.
Each voice rule can use no numbering, standard numbering, superscript numbering or two-digit padded numbering.
A name template of BOM with Superscript selected creates BOM¹, BOM², BOM³ and reuses the lowest available number after rooms close.
The {number} token can be placed explicitly in templates; if omitted from the main voice template while numbering is enabled, the number is appended automatically.
